==Part 3: Auburnvale, Tal Teklan & Skilling==
<div class="mw-collapsible">
{{Checklist|
* Run East to Quetzal ([[Renu]]), bird to [[Auburnvale]] (top left)
* Run South across bridge, Drink [[Cup of tea]]
* Run North to bank, deposit [[Steel mace]], [[Big fishing net]], [[Tyras helm]], [[Bucket]]
* Withdraw [[Axe]], [[Knife]], [[Cowhide]], [[Wool]]
* Run south to staff shop, buy [[Staff of air]] and [[Staff of fire]] (equip)
* Run west to Axe shop, buy [[Steel axe]], [[Mithril axe]], and [[Adamant axe]]
* Chop dead tree near river *Endless Harvest toggle autobank on* (stay until 45 logs banked if endless harvest)
* Withdraw log from bank if EH
* Make 1 [[Plank]] at [[Sawmill Operator (Auburnvale)|sawmill]] 
* Run southwest, tan [[Cowhide]] into [[Leather|regular leather]]
* Buy [[Needle]] and [[Thread]] in the general store
* Craft [[Leather chaps]]
* Admire beautiful logs just outside of gen store (east)
* Step on [[Ent trail]] (near maple trees to the south, wait for Ent to walk by)
* Run south to [[Nemus Retreat]]
* Claim [[Forestry kit]] from Forestry shop (southwest of nemus retreat near water)
* Equip forestry kit to enable Forestry events while WCing (lot of forestry tasks)
* Pick 6 [[Flax]]
* Spin [[Ball of wool]], 1 [[Bow string]]

'''Endless Harvesters/Woodsman can do the following, others can skip for now if you want:'''
* Fletch [[Headless arrow]]s until 20 [[Fletching]].
* Complete [[Vale Totems]] miniquest, bring 5 oak logs, 5 willow logs, 5 maple logs
* Chop oak to the south until 60 [[Oak logs]] banked. Complete Burn 1 oak log, Fletch 1 [[Oak shortbow]], fletch 25 [[Oak stock]]s, decorate [[Oak totem]] (5 oaks)
* Chop willows until 100 burn task, then toggle Woodsman burn off and bank 56 [[Willow logs]]: 1 [[Willow shortbow]], 50 [[Willow longbow (u)|willow longbows]] fletched, decorate [[Willow totem]] (5 willows)
* Finish 1000 [[Arrow shaft]]s with extra oaks or willows
* Chop 50 [[Maple logs]] (burn 25, bank 25)
* Fletch 25 [[Maple longbow (u)]]
* Deposit all, withdraw coins, axe, 2 bird snares, red cape, steel mace

* Run south to Rowboat, take boat to [[Tal Teklan]]
* Run west to rune shop, buy 5 of each elemental rune pack, 5 mind rune packs, 5 cosmics, 75 natures, 1 chaos pack, 1 death rune
* Cast [[Low Level Alchemy]] on anything for mage exp 
* Run west, buy [[Purple dye]]. Dye cape purple
* Run west, dance near [[Bard]]s on the dock
* Run southeast to ranged shop, buy 10 [[Iron arrow]]s, [[Shortbow]]
* Run to bank, deposit 5 nature runes
* Run east out of Tal Teklan, kill [[Frog]] near Doom dungeon shortcut (shoot 6+ iron arrows)
* Cut any regular tree

'''(Can skip the next step if not Woodsman. Birds are painful non-woodsman tasks, but you'll have to skip later puro tasks too if you don't do these now)'''
* Run north across bridge, then east to [[Crimson swift]]s
* Catch 8 Crimson swifts (16 if not woodsman)
* Run west to bridge, cross to the south then run southwest to [[Tropical wagtail]]s
* Catch 15 Tropical wagtails 
}}
</div>
